+- [ ] Add a round-trip test: a provenance with a `sourceTitle` reads back equal after a save and a reload of the record; a provenance with no title writes no key and reads back nil.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes (one full run).
+
+Requested by testudoapp-9a. Send the sha to it after the push.
